description: Retrieval regression baseline spanning test_papers/ (Attention Is All You Need, Adam, BERT, ResNet, Dropout). Each expected_page is 0-indexed and was verified by hand: the question's answer is actually present in a chunk on that (doc, page). This tests retrieval recall, not answer correctness -- it will catch 'the right passage stopped showing up' regressions in chunking/embedding. expected_doc is explicit since test_papers/ holds more than one PDF.
